dedupe_keys.name: nyc bike sharing network time series enhanced nodes and edges dataset

description: NYC Bike Sharing Network: Time-Series Enhanced Nodes and Edges Dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Constantin Urbainsky, Lyft Bikes & Scooters (NYC city bike sharing). This dataset presents a graph representation of the New York City Bike Sharing system, structured with nodes representing stations and edges delineating trips between these stations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
